chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Mahboub from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him); and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umeyr from Ahmad ibn Ali from Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

The jerboa, the hedgehog, and the lizard, when the one in Ihram kills them, upon him is a kid (young goat); and the young goat is better than it, but rather I have made this upon him so that he may be deterred from hunting something else.

key_terms.الضَّبُّ: Lizard (specifically the monitor lizard or similar species)
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: The one in Ihram (state of consecration for Hajj or Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for killing a jerboa or hedgehog while in Ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi specifies the fidya for killing the jerboa, hedgehog, and lizard while in Ihram, prescribing a young goat as compensation to deter further hunting. Shia scholars emphasize that the choice of a young goat serves a pedagogical purpose, encouraging the pilgrim to reflect on the value of the game taken. The ruling highlights the balance between ritual purity and practical compensation in Islamic jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik, from Abu Abdullahasws; and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ahmad Bin Ali, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘The jerboa (a rodent), and the hedgehog, and the lizard, when the one in Ihraam kills it, so upon him is a kid (young goat); and the young goat is better than it, but rather Iasws make this to be upon him to perhaps deter him from hunting something else’.
en.sarwar: 9. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from Misma’ ibn ‘Abd al-Malik from abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ahmad ibn Ali from Misma’ who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The expiation for killing a Jerboa, a hedgehog and lizard is one goat. The goat is better but it is made obligatory on him as penalty for hunting.’”
